title: Wire BoardModel into SessionStateMachine BOARD_MOVE/BOARD_RESOLVE + reconcile coin pools (GDD §5.6)
description: Filed from the TASK-031 review (rev-t031 FULL, AC6 seam ruling + LOW-5) and dev-t031's flagged design fork. TASK-031 delivered BoardModel as an engine-free Core model with a COMPATIBLE-BUT-UNWIRED seam: SessionStateMachine's BoardMove/BoardResolve phases are still 1-tick pass-through stubs (SessionPhase.cs documents them "Pass-through stub until BoardModel (Hito 4) is wired"), and BoardModel is referenced nowhere in runtime outside Core/Runtime/Board/. rev-t031 ruled AC6 SATISFIED on the seam reading (the IBoardModel surface matches what SessionStateMachine.Tick(in V2.InputSnapshot) already forwards; the additive BeginResolvePhase/TickResolve/ResolveFinished trio mirrors the Move trio) but recommended the actual wiring land as a separate step. THIS TICKET is that step. WORK: (1) Replace the BoardMove case body so it ticks BoardModel.TickMove(in InputSnapshot) until MoveFinished, and the BoardResolve case body so it drives the additive resolve trio (the <=4s Inversion stick window) then applies Resolve(rng)'s BoardResolution — WITHOUT adding any new SessionPhase enum member or changing the transition graph (AC6's "without FSM shape changes" carries forward). (2) Reconcile the coin pools: BoardModel currently owns self-contained balances (SetBalances, default 0, BoardModel.cs:99) independent of SessionStateMachine.Coins (fed today by microgame payouts only). GDD §5.6 implies a single shared economy (~60% microgames / ~40% board). Decide the ownership model (BoardModel reads/writes the session pool, or the session reconciles at phase boundaries) so coin flow has one source of truth. Coordinates with TASK-024 (FSM) and the fixed-60Hz driver work (TASK-055). Core wiring + reconciliation is fast-testable; any PlayMode session-integration leg rides a Unity gate window. Read GDD §5.2/§5.6 + §2.2 + Annex D.2 and re-read the TASK-031 Board/ module before coding.
acceptance_criteria: BoardMove/BoardResolve FSM phases drive the real BoardModel (TickMove until MoveFinished; the additive resolve trio for the <=4s Inversion window; BoardResolution applied) with NO new SessionPhase and no transition-graph change; §2.2 timeout budget respected

Coin economy is a single source of truth: BoardModel balances and SessionStateMachine.Coins are reconciled per §5.6; no coins created or destroyed across the microgame<->board boundary (conservation test spanning a full simulated session)
Determinism preserved end-to-end: same (seed, input sequence) yields an identical session final-state hash across the board phases
Tests-first for the wiring/reconciliation logic (fast-suite where engine-free; PlayMode/Unity-gate for session integration); fast suite green, no regression

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CLOSED via rev-t068 FULL review — VERDICT CLOSE, no HIGH, no MEDIUM, 3 LOW. Review depth = FULL (rubric: modifies the session FSM = core tdd-tier logic + shared state, mandatory-FULL; +647/-73, 3 files). Suites re-run firsthand: fast 647->654 (+7 net = 8 new -1 retired stub), 0 regressions in the ~465 pre-existing SSM/FSM tests; slow 8/8. CENTRAL FSM-TEST-LAUNDERING AUDIT CLEAR: the 6 semantic edits are legitimate absolute->delta re-bases (each still pins the exact payout/exclusion math; baseline captured at MgIntro right after BOARD_RESOLVE with NO board phase between it and FinalWager, so delta = pure microgame payout; not circular, strictness preserved); the ~30 loop-bound widenings are budget-only (exit condition + post-loop assertions unchanged); the retired BoardStubs_AdvanceWithinOneTick only pinned the now-false 1-tick-stub behavior (superseded by 4 new timing tests + FullGraph). AC1 no-shape-change CONFIRMED: SessionPhase.cs doc-only (zero enum/value changes), FullGraph_WalksEveryStateInOrder assertion body unchanged (only budget widened), no new SessionPhase/edge. AC2 conservation exact-BY-CONSTRUCTION (every _balances mutation paired 1:1 with a CoinDelta; ApplyCoinFlows replays each; Bank=-1 visible pot excluded from _coins; Coins==BoardSnapshot.Balances at all 7 resolves; non-vacuous, Coins>=0 every tick). AC3 determinism sound (Derive full-avalanches per roundNumber; -1 setup sentinel outside [0,TotalRounds) so no stream-position aliasing; BeginMovePhase rng provably ignored, Resolve gets a fresh instance). §2.2 budget (8s move / 4s resolve inside the 10s ceiling), zero-alloc (new allocs are per-round-boundary only, steady-state TickMove/MgPlay still 0 bytes), engine-free, tdd ordering genuine (ea038a6 compile-RED 10x CS1061 on missing BoardSnapshot) all pass. git hygiene clean (disclosed local-only reset --soft re-split never pushed). COIN-POOL MODEL [ASSUMED, technically sound + §5.6-compliant per rev-t068 LOW-2, HUMAN RATIFICATION PENDING]: SessionStateMachine.Coins is the single source of truth; board seeds-in via SetBalances at BOARD_MOVE / applies-out CoinFlows at BOARD_RESOLVE. New public seam SessionStateMachine.BoardSnapshot. FOLLOW-UP TASK-070 filed (LOW-1 idle-seat board-income policy human-ratification + LOW-3 dead-RNG-draw cleanup). Added coin-pool + board-income + BoardConfig/RNG-derivation choices to the human [ASSUMED] ratification list. Linked ea038a6/61064db/d863947, depth FULL.
